column2: Design an original corporate logo for a small 1980s personal-computer company called "phin tech". The symbol is the side-profile head silhouette of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears), simplified into one bold flat shape and filled with six horizontal stripes of colour from top to bottom: green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue. Beside it, the lowercase wordmark "phin tech" in a heavy, tightly spaced serif. Flat vector artwork, centered on a plain off-white background, no gradients, no outlines. It must not resemble any existing company's logo.

Design an original 1980s computer-company logo: the front-facing head of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with two floppy ears), reduced to a single bold flat silhouette with small negative-space eyes and nose, filled with six horizontal rainbow stripes (green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue from the top). Below it, "phin tech" in a heavy lowercase serif. Flat vector artwork on plain off-white, no gradients. It must not resemble any existing company's logo.

Design an original 1980s computer-company logo: a full-body silhouette of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt) sitting upright, head tilted, one floppy ear raised, drawn as one simple bold flat shape filled with six horizontal stripes of green, yellow, orange, red, purple and blue. Underneath, "PHIN TECH" in a wide geometric sans serif with generous letter spacing. Flat vector artwork on plain off-white, no gradients.

An original 1980s computer-company logo badge: a rounded square tile in deep navy containing the profile head silhouette of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears), simplified into a bold flat shape filled with six horizontal rainbow stripes (green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue). Thin cream keyline inside the tile edge. No text. Flat vector artwork, centered on plain off-white.

An original 1980s corporate logo in a single colour, deep blue on white: the profile head silhouette of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears) as one bold flat shape, sliced by evenly spaced horizontal white bands like scan lines, and beside it "PHIN TECH" in heavy slab-serif capitals sliced by the same white bands. Flat vector artwork, no gradients. It must not resemble any existing company's logo.

Design an original playful 1980s computer-company logo: the head of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt), three-quarter view, one floppy ear flipped up mid-wag, tongue out, simplified into a bold flat silhouette filled with six horizontal stripes of green, yellow, orange, red, purple and blue, with a tiny white sparkle near the ear. To the right, "phin tech" in a chunky rounded lowercase. Flat vector on plain off-white, no gradients.

Design an original 1980s computer-company logo: a rounded beige CRT monitor outline drawn in bold black lines, and on its screen the profile head silhouette of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears) filled with six horizontal rainbow stripes (green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue). Below, "phin tech" in a heavy serif. Flat vector artwork on plain off-white.

A photograph of a polished, engraved brass shop plaque mounted on dark walnut wood, warm light. Engraved and enamel-inlaid on it is the profile head silhouette of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears) filled with six horizontal stripes of enamel colour (green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue), beside the engraved words "phin tech" in a classic serif. Realistic detail, 1980s store sign.

A glossy die-cut vinyl sticker from a 1984 computer store, photographed flat on a white surface: the profile head silhouette of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears) filled with six horizontal rainbow stripes (green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue) and a thin white border around the shape. No text. Slight sheen, soft shadow.

A 1985 corporate letterhead and business card for "phin tech", photographed on a wooden desk in warm light. The logo is the profile head silhouette of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears) filled with six horizontal rainbow stripes (green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue), next to "phin tech" in a heavy serif. Cream paper, embossed feel, a fountain pen beside it.

A boxed 1990s Macintosh software package standing on a wooden shelf, photographed in warm store light. Across the bottom of the box is a black band with the logo: the profile head silhouette of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears) filled with six horizontal rainbow stripes, beside the words "phin tech" in a heavy cream serif. The box front art above is an abstract airbrushed sky. The only words anywhere are "phin tech".

A macOS app icon in rich 2010-era skeuomorphic style: a rounded square of polished walnut wood with a bevelled edge, inlaid in the centre with the profile head silhouette of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears) made of six horizontal strips of coloured enamel (green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue), with a soft glossy highlight. No text.
